## Sallie Mae CEO to Speak at TD Cowen 2026 Financials & Fintech Conference


11/09/2026


Download this Press Release PDF Format (opens in new window)


NEWARK, Del.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Sallie Mae® (Nasdaq: SLM), formally SLM Corporation, today announced Chief Executive Officer Jon Witter will participate in a fireside chat at the TD Cowen 2026 Financials & Fintech Conference on Tuesday, Nov. 17, at 11:45 a.m. ET.


A live audio webcast and replay will be available at[SallieMae.com/investors](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.salliemae.com%2Finvestors%2F&esheet=54638243&newsitemid=20261109718553&lan=en-US&anchor=SallieMae.com%2Finvestors&index=1&md5=d873f42661d6fc946969dd82d46126c8) .


**Sallie Mae** (Nasdaq: SLM) believes education and life-long learning, in all forms, help people achieve great things. As the leader in private student lending, we provide financing and know-how to support access to college and offer products and resources to help customers make new goals and experiences, beyond college, happen. Learn more at[SallieMae.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.salliemae.com%2F&esheet=54638243&newsitemid=20261109718553&lan=en-US&anchor=SallieMae.com&index=2&md5=c658a599ba57bd9f204059cfdf839aca) . Commonly known as Sallie Mae, SLM Corporation and its subsidiaries are not sponsored by or agencies of the United States of America.
